name: ytdl
description: Invoke the user's yt-dlp toolkit on Ops for published transcripts, ASR fallback and media tasks.

interface.longDescription: Run the version-controlled yt-dlp toolkit on Ops. YouTube video URLs prefer published transcripts before local ASR, with media, metadata, captions and more available.
defaultPrompt: Extract the available YouTube transcript, using local speech recognition only if missing.
Show the available formats for this URL.
